INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Read the request carefully. If it mentions a page or section by name (e.g. logo page, clients page, placements), map it to the files above.
2. Use your read tools to look at the relevant files BEFORE making changes so you understand the existing code.
3. Make only the requested change — nothing else.
